attributes.board_name: Junta de Farmacia de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education; no limit on hours by module, journal or internet

topics.who: All pharmacists: 'Equidad y Respeto' course on bioethics and discrimination (Adm. Order 2024-583, since Jan 4, 2024)
Pharmacists with a Certificate for Administration of Vaccines: at least 1 contact hour (0.1 CEU) on immunization each year, plus current basic CPR
Pharmacists with a Certificate for Administration of Vaccines: current basic CPR

rules.notes: Recertification every 3 years under Ley 247-2004 and Ley 11-1976; evidence of CE and Colegio de Farmacéuticos membership filed with the recertification. Board sheet: 35 hours, renewal fee $250; renew about 90 days before expiry. Residents outside PR may present all 35 hours online/modules.
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 247 de 3 de septiembre de 2004, según enmendada, Arts. 2.02, 4.06, 4.07; Orden Administrativa 2024-583
rules.rule_quote: Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Farmacéutico (38) ➢ 35 horas Educación Continua
